_about: Tobin Varrow, Liss's older brother, about 26, a Saltwright of Hollowmere: charming, idealistic, can't stop grinning (act2_ch14.md B01: 'in a Saltwright wedding coat with a Warden's red sash over it, both families' colours'; liss_varrow.md: he volunteered so nobody would have to be chosen). Killed shielding Merel (B05 `tobin_falls`: he sits down on the slabs, surprised, one hand on the knotted cord). Liss's family face (her skin, ancestry mix and eye tilt; act1_npcs.md §2.10) on a taller, broader man; dark-brown crop. The coat: a long-sleeved hip-length Saltwright coat in indigo_dye, sand-cloth trousers to the shin, the Warden's sash lacquer_red with long tails, sandals. An eleven-mark Saltwright record on the right side (forearm 5, upper arm 4 under the sleeve, two up the collarbone and neck showing at the coat's V) (liss_textures' generator). M4-A2P-050. Face sliders relative to the MakeHuman donor (ADR 0021: 1.0 / 0.0 = unchanged). Keys starting with '_' are read by the villager_* modules, not by bb_params.
name: tobin
